title: 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge
heroContent:
Welcome to the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge!

Join us and explore The Next Frontier on November 14-15.

featuredImage.title: 2026 theme website hero v10
featuredImage.alt: The Next Frontier theme shows an astronaut in a blue space suit on the moon looking towards Mars, with Mars appearing in the reflection of the astronaut's helmet.
featuredImage.caption: 2026 theme website hero v10

tasks.title: CREATE ACCOUNT
tasks.description: The first step in your hackathon journey is to create a NASA Space Apps account or log in to your existing account.

tasks.title: REGISTER FOR THE HACKATHON
tasks.description: To participate and be eligible for Global Judging, you must first register for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. You can register up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

tasks.title: CHOOSE A LOCAL EVENT
tasks.description: Connect with the NASA Space Apps community by choosing an in-person or virtual Local Event near you. If you don’t have a Local Event near you, choose the virtual Universal Event. You can choose or change your event up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

tasks.title: JOIN OR FORM A TEAM
tasks.description: Collaborate with participants by forming or joining a team according to your chosen challenge. Teams should have no more than six participants. You can choose or change your team up until the hackathon closes on November 15.

tasks.title: SUBMIT A PROJECT
tasks.description: To edit and submit your project, go to the Project Tab on your Team’s page. Project submission opens on Saturday, November 14 at 9:00 AM and closes on Sunday, November 15 at 11:59 PM local time. Submit your project to receive a participant certificate and to be eligible for Global Judging. We encourage all participants to submit what they accomplish over the course of the hackathon.

tasks.title: Complete the Participant Survey
tasks.description: Share your feedback about your hackathon journey to help improve future events.
